race.comment: LIVALITTLE (5) came with a powerful finish from last on the bend but just ran out of ground last start over this course and distance. May race a pair or two closer from a much better draw this time. Very honest miler who gets his chance to return to the winner's list. Waller sent BARBRAY (12) to Brisbane recently and it has proved a winning move with back-to-back victories, the latest over 1815m here three weeks ago. Stepping up in grade but drops 5.5kgs. Sure to be winding up strongly at the end of this. LAST COMMAND (3) made late inroads but was never a threat first-up over 1400m at this track last start. Has a much better second-up record and 1600m is more his go. Capable of featuring. CUNNAMULLA FELLA (1) is racing in great heart with three top two finishes at Doomben of late. Big chance on the back of a near miss last Saturday in open company. NORTH POLE (2) was brave in defeat over today's journey at Doomben a fortnight ago. Rarely far from the cash.
